summary: Only 8 m of kerb, beside a footpath and car park entrance.
reasons: Footpath meets kerb at the start

drivers.seclusion: Backs onto a small car park and trees; nearest home 31 m away.
drivers.access_and_room: Kerb is 8 m, too short for a van to stand clear of the path entrance.
drivers.convention: Cars park further along the road, but not on this short stretch.

flags: Mapped lift gate 8 m away has a way round
Low-lying: about 9.5 m elevation, river 209 m away
sun_shade: Open to the sun; trees to the south and west cast partial shade.
